tasks.original_prompt:
Anemia follow-up: from the first low hemoglobin in the current run, was a repeat drawn, what did it show, and is the most recent value still low?
Context: patient MRN SYN-a6491bf8ea (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2023-06-05, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. answer is {"low": ..., "rechecked": ..., "recheck": ..., "recheck_ordered": ..., "latest": ..., "still_low": ...}. low is the first result of the most recent run of consecutive low results, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). rechecked (boolean) is whether any result is dated after low. recheck is the first result after low (same keys), and recheck_ordered (YYYY-MM-DD) the authoredOn date of the ServiceRequest its basedOn references; both null when not rechecked. latest is the most recent result (same keys) and still_low (boolean) whether it is low. Every field is null when no result is low. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (low, the recheck and its ServiceRequest, and latest; when no result is low, every hemoglobin result considered), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.

tasks.original_prompt:
Missed-dose notification: message the ordering prescriber about this patient's dose that was not given.
Context: patient MRN SYN-a6491bf8ea (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2023-05-14, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. answer is {"date": ..., "notified": ...} for the MedicationAdministration with status not-done: date (its effectiveDateTime date, YYYY-MM-DD). Create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $prescriber with the Practitioner who is the requester of the MedicationRequest that the administration's request references, and $administration with the administration: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$prescriber"}], "about": [{"reference": "$administration"}]}. notified (boolean) is whether you created it. When the patient has no such administration, date is null, notified is false, nothing is created, and that answer must rest on a search of this patient's MedicationAdministration records filtered by patient only (only _count may be added) that returns no records. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the administration, its MedicationRequest and the Practitioner), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.

Reply with only JSON: {"answer": {date: date YYYY-MM-DD, notified: true/false}, "evidence": [references of the records you used, Type/id]}. Use null for any value the chart does not have.
